scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:size && pnpm check:packages && pnpm test
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.test:visual:docker: docker run --rm --ipc=host --network=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work/e2e -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble npx playwright test --grep @visual --project chromium
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host --network=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work/e2e mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble npx playwright test --grep @visual --project chromium --update-snapshots
